basic_info.description: Experience the epitome of contemporary design in this meticulously updated 2-bed, 2.5 bath condo, The Stanford Place. Built in 1911, this beautiful top-floor unit with abundance of natural light is located in the iconic Nob Hill neighborhood of SF. Boasting over 2000sqft of living space, the grand foyer & open concept living room with wood burning fireplace, Bay windows & recessed lighting, showcases living in luxury. Dining room with 2nd wood Burning Fireplace, built-in bookshelves & kitchen with S/S appliances, perfect for the inspired home chef. Overlooking the tranquil, shared garden, your primary bedroom with walk in closet & remodeled ensuite bath plus a 2nd bed with adjoining updated bathroom provide an enchanting oasis. Dine al-fresco on the shared roof deck with impressive SF skyline views. Host a party or relax with the sunset. With a bonus room, Laundry Room, plenty of storage & 1 car parking offers the perfect blend of old-world charm & modern updates. Distinctive features: hardwood floors, stained glass windows, skylights, quartz countertops & dual pane windows. An interior & faade brimming with charm, this stunning home seamlessly fits into the prime SF locale. Surrounded by shopping, dining, entertainment & just steps away from many renowned SF cultural attraction
